evaluation_versions.evaluation_change: v1->v2 changes one evaluation value: cream_cheese peak cap 75.93 -> 52.02 N (butter 51.22 -> 51.20; hold bands change <=0.2 N). Calibration protocol unchanged. Caps are operational force caps from dev-trajectory statistics, not object-damage thresholds. v1 and v2 pass rates are on different inits and different caps and must not be pooled or compared as a trend.
evaluation_versions.cap_origin: v1 cream peak cap came from two firm-plan dev trajectories with sub-step finger-rim contact (inits 9: 60.7 N, 12: 56.7 N); after the raised transport the same inits give 41.6 N (v2).

init16.plan_letter_check: verified in recorded arrays: letters=(cream,butter); FG executes cream target band (35,100) and butter band (1,22); GG executes (1,22) for both; force_target and hold_instance switch at each object's grasp.
init16.peak_definition: audit peak_total_n = max over control steps of (left per-finger sub-step max + right per-finger sub-step max) = conservative upper bound. At init16 butter FG/FF the left and right maxima occur in the same sub-step, so the same-sub-step L+R max is also 69.5 N (44.2 L + 25.2 R); the 69.5 N is a measured synchronous value here, with asymmetric fingers.
init16.prefix_evidence: butter and eef poses at butter-approach start are identical to <0.05 mm (eef/butter pose only; the full physical and control state was not shown to be identical) in all four combos; cream-cheese pose in the basket differs by 1.9 mm between firm and gentle prefixes and the butter approach starts one control step later (220 vs 219). Both firm-prefix combos (FG, FF) give 69.5 N on the butter at the 6th grasp step, before the butter's own plan can matter (FG and FF identical); both gentle-prefix combos give 40.1-40.4 N. Gentle in the same prefix situation over inits 14,15,18-21: FG butter 35.7-38.4 N.
init16.contact_evidence: in all four init16 combos fingers/hand press on living_room_table_col with 13-20 N during the closing steps (init14 control: none); the butter is pushed ~2.5 mm in y by the left finger one step before the right finger touches (L-only 8.5-10.3 N at step 5).
init16.conclusion: 黄油抓取存在指尖压桌和先后接触不对称；峰值与前序方式条件关联，但放大机制及因果关系尚未隔离。Not an instance-switching or controller-history bug. Kept as a failure (peak 69.5 N > cap 51.2 N; GG/GF butter peaks 40.1-40.4 N). Step 9 candidates (not a unique fix): adjust butter approach/grasp geometry, or other stage edits. Recovery point depends on the actual edit: if the butter approach geometry is edited, resume from before that parameter takes effect; if a cream-cheese stage is edited, recover earlier and do not reuse the already-affected old prefix. No further mechanism chase.
